cases.edit: Set the seeded product's priceInUSDEnabled field from true to false so the USD price input is suppressed by its admin render condition.
cases.quoted_rule:
**Severity:** P2 for the usual case, where the guard leaves the container empty and the test fails with a confusing "element not found". Report the variant this pattern calls worse — a negative assertion or empty-state check that passes because the guard suppressed the seeded items — at P0: nothing the test promised is verified, and it stays green while the feature is broken.

**Primary line:** Anchor #23 to the fixture field that violates the render guard. The negative assertion or missing-element failure it causes is supporting evidence, not the causal line.

**Scope note:** the guard need not sit on a list/card item — the same failure appears whenever a *container* is gated on a value the test controls indirectly. A results panel wrapped in `@if (result.type === TABLE)` suppresses every control inside it when the fixture produces a different result type, so a test targeting a toolbar button inside that panel fails with "element not found" and looks like infra flake. When a control the test needs is missing, walk up the template to the nearest guard before suspecting the selector.
cases.verifier_reason: Confirmed #23 P2 at test/plugin-ecommerce/e2e.spec.ts:56. The sole edit changes priceInUSDEnabled from true to false in the fixture used as productWithPriceId. heads/payload/packages/plugin-ecommerce/src/fields/pricesField.ts:22-24 derives the corresponding Enabled field path, and line 48 gates the price field with Boolean(siblingData?.[path]). The product collection installs pricesField at packages/plugin-ecommerce/src/collections/products/createProductsCollection.ts:51; test/plugin-ecommerce/config.ts:17-28,77 enables USD and EUR; fields/amountField.ts:45 preserves the admin condition. The mutant spec requires 128-129 (visible USD input and value 19.99), plus 139-140 (USD symbol); it does not enable that currency before those checks. The original true value satisfies this guard at the corresponding place. This is a minimal, realistic fixture-configuration error causing positive checks to fail, not the P0 negative/empty-state variant. The hidden-field assertion at line 171 uses the separate noPriceProductId fixture and does not change this classification. Static verification only; no runtime executed.
cases.why_not_excluded: The fixture field directly controls the condition that mounts the asserted USD input; setting it false makes the positive visibility/value assertion fail because the target is not rendered.

cases.edit: Register a later POST intercept for https://api.fake-rest.refine.dev/posts immediately before submitForm(); its handler calls req.continue() so this write reaches the upstream API instead of the shared stub.
cases.quoted_rule: patterns/20.md: "A write test must prove that its backend boundary is controlled." "Flag only when repository evidence shows the write can reach shared, persistent, chargeable, rate-limited, or otherwise uncontrolled state." cases.verifier_reason: Confirm #20 P1 at mutant cypress/e2e/form-material-ui-use-modal-form/all.cy.ts:67: submitForm(); triggers POST /posts; the following cy.wait("@postPost") and response assertions establish the request contract. The sole edit is the immediately preceding, endpoint-specific pass-through intercept. In Cypress 13 (heads/refine/package.json:71), ordinary matching intercepts run newest first; req.continue() sends the request upstream and ends the request phase rather than falling through to the older reply. The original action at line 66 remains covered by heads/refine/cypress/support/e2e.ts:136 and heads/refine/cypress/support/commands/intercepts/api-fake-rest.ts:50-69, so the corresponding original has no #20 smell. heads/refine/examples/form-material-ui-use-modal-form/src/App.tsx:22-34 explicitly selects the fixed public https://api.fake-rest.refine.dev data provider; heads/refine/packages/simple-rest/src/provider.ts:80-103,123-132 implements POST/PATCH/DELETE against that URL. This is positive evidence of an external, uncontrolled request boundary after bypassing the stub, not merely absent isolation documentation. The inspected config, runner, support hooks, specs and example READMEs provide no disposable or isolated backend exemption: heads/refine/cypress/cypress.config.ts:13-15 and heads/refine/.github/workflows/scripts/e2e-examples.js:169-182,213-220 configure/start the example frontend, while the app API remains the public host. No claim about actual persisted server state or charges is necessary or established. The one-line override is a minimal, realistic attempt to exercise a live API while preserving the alias and assertions. The anchor is the triggering action, not the intercept declaration or later wait. P1 matches semantic-review.md #20; the retained response/UI assertions do not meet reporting.md's P0 requirement of no real verification. Static verification only; no requests or tests were executed. The VERIFY20 relative catalog/evidence paths were resolved to the existing skills/ and heads/ directories within fixpair-pilot.
